description: Every row must have a child identifier
A child can appear only once per school and assessment wave
Birth date is required to compute age
Kindergarten children must be between 3 and 7 years old (36-84 months)
Age must be consistent with the declared school year (P3/P4/P5)
Vocabulary score out of the test range (0-40)
Phonological awareness score out of range (0-30)
Letter knowledge score out of range (0-27)
Assessment date must be after birth date
